claims.reason: Number, unit and comparator direction match the page and the house convention ('< onset (time_ago N)' = within last N). But the red box says 'Sexual assault/rape' and SNOMED 'Victim of rape' / 'Victim of sexual aggression' are NOT descendants of 'Victim of forced sexual activity' (siblings under 'Victim of sexual abuse'), so a patient recorded as a rape victim never fires this branch.

rules.rule: Check for traumatised/abused patient urgent signs and abuse type
rules.problem: Type, trigger and grouping are right and every check_for item is consumed. But (1) 'Intimidation' is the perpetrator-side concept (child of Aggressive behavior, a warning sign); (2) the page's 'unusual wounds', 'harassment', 'ridiculed/controlled', 'insulted' are not checked although (snomed_concept "Wound" "disorder"), (snomed_concept "Victim of verbal abuse" "finding") and (snomed_concept "Victim of bullying" "finding") exist; (3) sex is checked as clinical findings 'Female'/'Male', which the grammar permits but which may never match how VHA records sex, leaving the sexual-assault red-box branch dead.

Only 'behaviour seems strange' of the four 'Suspect abuse if' cues is encoded; disclosure is the trigger finding itself and 'examination contradicts history' has no SNOMED concept, so this is acceptable.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable sexual assault/rape (traumatised/abused patient page)
rules.problem: Faithful to 'If forced to do any form of sexual act without consent, sexual assault/rape likely'. Unlike its two siblings it is not gated on the page trigger, which is harmless.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable physical abuse (traumatised/abused patient page)
rules.problem: 'Unusual wounds' is missing from the or-group; 'Scar' and 'Multiple bruising' are wider than 'old/new scars' and 'bruises of different ages'. Gating on the trigger keeps a plain surgical scar from firing it outside this page's context.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable emotional/verbal/psychological abuse (traumatised/abused patient page)
rules.problem: 'Intimidation' is the wrong side of the act (patient intimidating others); harassment, ridiculed/controlled and insulted are not represented although 'Victim of verbal abuse' / 'Victim of bullying' exist; the diagnosis concept 'Victim of emotional abuse' does not subsume the verbal and psychological siblings the page names.

rules.rule: Urgent: traumatised/abused patient with recent sexual assault, injuries or suicide risk
rules.problem: Urgent is justified by 'Give urgent attention' and the (and trigger (or ...)) shape matches the box. Time windows and comparator direction follow the house convention. Problems: the sexual-assault branch fires only on 'Victim of forced sexual activity' (a rape victim recorded as 'Victim of rape' or 'Victim of sexual aggression', the concept the page's own probable rule produces, is not a descendant) and depends on sex being recorded as a clinical finding; 'Injuries needing attention' is widened to any traumatic injury.

summary: The one outright error is 'Intimidation' (c015, c032): in SNOMED it is a child of 'Aggressive behavior' and means the patient is intimidating others, so as evidence of emotional abuse it is the wrong side of the act and would also light a warning sign. The red-box sexual-assault branch keys only on 'Victim of forced sexual activity', which does not subsume 'Victim of rape' or 'Victim of sexual aggression' (the page's own probable diagnosis), and relies on sex being recorded as 'Female'/'Male' clinical findings, so it risks never firing. Lesser imprecisions: 'Injuries needing attention' becomes any injury, 'old/new scars' and 'bruises of different ages' lose their qualifiers, 'unusual wounds', 'harassment', 'ridiculed/controlled' and 'insulted' are not encoded, and 'Victim of emotional abuse' names only one of the three abuse types the page lists.
